responsibility: This assembler include file provides the NDS32 startup macro used by runtime or board-support code to initialize execution state. Its nds32_init macro sets up the small-data base register, conditionally initializes EX9 instruction-table support, enables and configures the FPU when present, and establishes the default stack pointer, so it serves as a target-supplied startup sequence template rather than part of GCC’s RTL backend proper.
